rsi make_the_improver_editable F2 and other conditions quote outcome statistics of named members (e.g. 'an accepted member reports fourteen percent…' = Gödel Agent itself); for blind seats this leaks the outcome of a paper under review — strip outcome wording from conditions used as expectations.
anchor_proposals_ranked: 1. No-experiment framework/theory papers: E sub-items are not_reported=0 (with search_scope) unless the paper itself gives a formal result bearing directly on the item (verifier soundness → E.measurement ≤1; proven cost bound → E.cost ≤1). By-construction guarantees are credited once, in M/X; a 'formal counterfactual' is not E.causality. (PowerPlay spread 66.25 vs 43.75 came entirely from this.)

2. One issue, one E item: oracle/ground-truth retry signals and selection-set reuse → E.holdout; small n / no intervals → E.statistics; unmatched compute or single-sample baselines → E.causality and E.cost; E.measurement is metric/verifier validity only (incl. trivial-baseline checks such as majority label when the fitness rewards label diversity). Proposed E.statistics ladder: 1 = denominators/negatives but no uncertainty on headline results; 2 = test-item CIs or a failure denominator over repeated runs but no search-seed variance; 3 = seeds + CIs + significance + per-task counts; 4 = additionally pre-registered/independent replication.

3. Scope boundary at the evaluated object: out_of_scope when both the improver update and the product are weights, even if code is generated and reused (weight-space operators); in scope when a retained non-weight harness artifact is what is evaluated, even if the improver is weight-trained (H26/H27). Theory-only self-modification incentive papers are out_of_scope (not low scores).

4. RS layer: generative_process_redesign is drifting into a catch-all ('liberate any fixed thing'); require the liberated component to be part of an iterative/staged procedure (accepted: Gödel Agent's meta-algorithm; rejected: PowerPlay's task set → self_supervised_signal_engineering/C08; GrIPS's instruction text → outside_taxonomy). Primary = load-bearing operation, delivery channel = supporting (Reflexion).

5. Freeze a canonical expectation-ID list per card condition (e.g. rsi:<main>/<S|F|Hxx-step>n). Seats invented incompatible IDs (SOL-REF-1, rsi.H19.anchor vs rsi:make_the_improver_editable/S1), so all 53 expectation-field entries among the 95 mechanical conflicts had one side null (ID mismatch); after merging by question only about six reflected genuine status differences (e.g. H19 anchor partial vs unmet, H23 external certification partial vs unmet, contamination met vs partial). Also forbid status=unknown when material is complete (use unmet/partial) and require not_applicable when applicable=false.

6. Retained vs task for same-distribution tests: a disjoint test split of the same tasks earns 'retained' only if the rule choosing the tested snapshot/cycle is stated; otherwise keep 'retained' but cap E.holdout at 2 (Gödel Agent).
